prompt: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering of a wide side-scrolling arcade shooter stage backdrop, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, crisp pixel-art texture accents, subtle CRT scanline glow, lifted deep-navy shadows, never pure black. The interior of a colossal fortress-ship, a long industrial hall seen side-on and built from horizontal parallax bands. Ceiling band: three parallel runs of pipes of different diameters with regular flange rings, bending into elbows and diving into the walls, and a travelling crane rail with a hanging hook block fading into shadow. Far band: the end wall is dominated by a giant circular pressure hatch of concentric locking rings with a single small amber viewport glowing at its center, flanked by blast doors as wide as houses. Wall band: colossal riveted gunmetal plates with regular rows of rivet heads and seam welds, banded with dark outlines, steam bleeding in slow white ribbons from two big valve wheels. Gantry band: walkway gratings and cantilevered catwalks crossing at two levels with sturdy vertical stanchions and hazard-striped edges, long rows of small amber running lamps along their edges, each throwing a cone of warm orange light onto the steel and linking into a receding chain of glow, deep blue-black shadow between the pools of light. Floor band: heavy steel deck plating with grilles and floor-edge lamps. Gunmetal greys and dark steel blues with committed warm amber lighting. No characters, no text, no letters, no numbers, no signs, no user interface.
